title: Absolute Green Lantern
blurb: Jo and her Green Lantern Corps head home from the war just as Cameron Chase gets ready to open the Manhunter File, and the series finally starts answering its biggest questions.

title: Absolute Superman
blurb: The hunt for Brainiac continues, and Superman recruits Steel. First, though, Steel needs a brand-new suit of armour.

title: Batgirl
blurb: With Gotham overrun by the superbloom, Batgirl has to get a sick baby across the city to Gotham General while Tenji and Jaya defend the noodle shop. Part of Batman: Bad Seeds.

title: The Deadman
blurb: Boston Brand lands in a future where the Earth's ghosts have vanished for good. Human again, he has to survive a strange, soulless tomorrow full of twisted versions of familiar faces.

title: The Demon
blurb: James Harren writes and draws a new take on Etrigan. Jason Blood, centuries old and split in two, tries to protect a world being fed on by beasts from Hell.

title: DC's Quoth the Raven… Whatever
blurb: A spooky-season anthology of strange, occult stories starring Raven, Swamp Thing, Constantine, Zatanna, Deadman and more.

title: Jonah Hex and the Shadow of Death
blurb: Michael Walsh brings horror to the Old West. A worn-out Jonah Hex thought his story was over, until something ancient and evil arrives in the town of Ashecott.

title: JSA
blurb: Wildcat, Dr. Midnite and Hourman are trapped behind enemy lines and have to rescue a former teammate, in the final Justice Society story of the run.

title: Superman: The Stranger
blurb: Clark wants to help the people nobody sees, and finds an ally in Lois Lane, a reporter whose articles might show him where to start.

title: The Adventures of Superman
blurb: A reprint of the 1993 Reign of the Supermen issue, with the original ads, that introduced the Superboy clone.

title: Batman
blurb: A reprint of the 1988 classic with Todd McFarlane's famous cover, in which three cops each tell their own story about the Dark Knight.

title: Swamp Thing
blurb: A reprint of the 1972 first issue by Len Wein and Bernie Wrightson, where Alec Holland becomes the Swamp Thing.

title: Midnight Fantastic Four
blurb: A horror twist on the First Family. An obsessive scientist digs into secrets best left alone, and he and three others come back warped in terrible ways. By Benjamin Percy and Kev Walker.

title: Midnight Spider-Man
blurb: Oscorp turns a young Peter Parker into a monstrous spider hybrid in its search for eternal life. When they start making more hybrids, Peter uses his new form to stop them.

title: Midnight X-Men
blurb: A dark new Marvel line begins. Vampires and mutants share the shadows of New York under a fragile peace, and war is close. With Jonathan Hickman.

title: Avengelyne
blurb: The avenging angel returns. A priest losing his faith meets a mysterious angel, and a wealthy demon lord sends his forces to turn her to his side.

title: Crowbound
blurb: Jeff Lemire and Dustin Nguyen's dark fantasy continues. Rose has been killed and sunk in the swamp, but something in the depths might save her, at a price.

title: Deadly Tales of the Gunslinger Spawn
blurb: The Gunslinger tears across the West looking for Zyanya, and is shocked to learn who took her.

title: Death Vigil
blurb: Clara can't tell friend from foe, and new trouble with Mia drags up Bernadette's past. Workplace drama, centuries deep.

title: G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero / Tomb Raider
blurb: G.I. Joe and Lara Croft meet for the first time, on Cobra Island. A new limited series by Kyle Higgins and Elena Casagrande.

title: Luther Strode
blurb: Skinny, average Luther Strode finds an old book called The Method hidden in a used bookstore, and it changes him far more than he expected. The first issue, back for its 15th anniversary.

title: Luther Strode
blurb: The oversized treasury version of the 15th anniversary first issue, where Luther discovers The Method.

title: M.A.S.K.
blurb: Matt Trakker tried to keep his son Scott safe from V.E.N.O.M. It didn't work, and now Scott is on the M.A.S.K. network.

title: Of the Earth
blurb: The finale. Abby takes on the Wildcatter creature, if she can survive its grip.

title: Starhenge, Book Two: A Kiss for Atticus
blurb: Amber, Daryl and Merlin are back together, but escaping their strange prison means trusting a new friend from the enemy's side.

title: Tales of Wonder
blurb: America's Freedom Force has come to our world. If Stu and Jake's comic book heroes are real, where are the villains?

title: The Walking Dead Deluxe
blurb: The full-colour Walking Dead reaches a breaking point.

title: Something Is Killing the Children
blurb: Erica Slaughter returns in the milestone 50th issue. Shattered after the Tribulation saga and hunted by the Order, she runs to the Valmont Mountain Lodge.

title: Minor Arcana
blurb: Jeff Lemire's Ballad of Budd St. Pierre continues as Budd tries to make peace with his past, and his choices ripple down the family tree.

title: Altered States: Warlords
blurb: In Dynamite's what-if reality, Helium is losing its war on Barsoom until a starship brings Vampirella. Will she save the planet or doom it?

title: Ben 10: Creator Files
blurb: A behind-the-scenes look at the new Ben 10 series, from script to finished page, with creator interviews, unseen art and a first look at the next villain.

title: Red Sonja: She-Devil with a Sword
blurb: After the battle with Rising Sun, Red Sonja takes a break to attend a wedding, where the bride turns out to be less than human.

title: Supernatural: Dean Winchester
blurb: Hurt and alone at Mardi Gras in New Orleans, Dean sets out to close a case his dad never could, even if it means killing a god. By Chuck Brown and Rapha Lobosco.

title: Supernatural: Sam Winchester
blurb: After doing something to Dean he can't take back, Sam is drawn to a mysterious farmhouse in the middle of nowhere. By Paulina Ganucheau and Kendall Goode.

title: Beneath the Trees Where Nobody Sees: Halloween Special
blurb: A one-shot set years after Samantha Strong left Woodbrook. Her legend keeps growing, and not every murder blamed on her is hers. With Patrick Horvath, James Tynion IV and more.

title: Godzilla: Kai Sei Era
blurb: Godzilla lives inside teenage G-Force operative Jacen Braid. As the old enemies start working together, Jacen uncovers the US government's part in his origin.

title: Godzilla's Monsterpiece Theatre Presents: The Kaiju of Oz
blurb: Godzilla goes to Oz to meet the Wizard. Ryan Browne's comedy smashes the Emerald City.

title: Star Trek: Holo-Ween II
blurb: A Halloween mystery on Deep Space 9. With a summit about to start and the senior staff away, Worf, Dax, Odo and Bashir face a blackout and a string of eerie incidents.

title: TMNT: Journeys
blurb: April calls Renet across space and time for help with her origins, while Raph's mutation spirals and Leo hunts a new enemy.

title: Concrete: Stars Over Sand
blurb: Maureen survives a terrifying ordeal on a failing helicopter, Larry tracks Concrete into the mountains, and another killer closes in.

title: Grendel: Devil's Crucible – Sedition
blurb: Grendel's Hounds of Orion plan their attack as Anti-Grendel Squads close in. Matt Wagner's saga continues.

title: Groo: The Prophecy
blurb: The finale. Groo has no idea why the prophecies keep going wrong, but he's here to protect the townsfolk. By Sergio Aragonés and Mark Evanier.

title: Hellboy in Hell: Nothing But Blood
blurb: Deep in Hell during an uprising, Hellboy saves a young woman from winged beasts, but nobody is what they seem. By Mike Mignola and Cyrille Pomès.

title: Kill All Immortals III
blurb: Frey Asvald broke away from her immortal Viking family. Now rival immortals want them all dead, and she has to decide what matters most.

title: Kingdom of Earth
blurb: The Dark Watcher Orpheus hunts the human resistance in Chicago, Virago lives a double life, and Frankie heads into the Northern Territory alone.

title: Only the Savage Are Left
blurb: Ryder fights marauders and monsters in the post-apocalypse and faces the sacrifice it may take to save his first love.

title: The Ring: The Man Who Beat the Man
blurb: Liam the Bulldog's next fight is a media circus, but Ivan the Bear only came to hurt him, while Ramon the Lion watches and plans his comeback. Written by Gail Simone.

title: The Shaolin Cowboy: Staying A.I.live
blurb: The finale. Corporate villain Emil Cola has the Shaolin Cowboy blinded and seemingly helpless. Geof Darrow's chaos comes to an end.

title: Witness Point
blurb: Nathan Fillion's Midwestern murder mystery takes Sheriff Kite Calhoon and Deputy Marshal Priya Khabrani to Baraboo's shady Circus City.

title: The Dirt Beneath the Devil
blurb: Chased across the frontier by mysterious riders, June and the other heirs turn on each other as secrets about William Buckley's legacy come out.

title: Honor and Curse: Eternal
blurb: Genshi races across Exit City with the Tengu clinging to his soul, and a betrayal changes everything.

title: Land of Never
blurb: Two fathers close in on their lost children and learn the horrifying origins of the Floating Man.

title: Pop Kill: Big Candy
blurb: The Cola Wars are over and the Sugar Wars begin. Dina's new sugar substitute puts her and Jon on a candy cartel's hit list.

title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch
blurb: A new ongoing series for comics' most famous witch-in-training, just in time for Halloween. By Corinna Bechko and Kano.

title: Flux House Presents
blurb: Matt Kindt hosts a new quarterly anthology of mind-bending stories and first appearances, introducing upcoming Flux House series.

title: Dinner Date
blurb: Dating is hard enough. Syd was just trying to get over her ex when a date turned her into a vampire.

title: Minotaur
blurb: Gloria Monday's first mission ends in fire as CIA agent Koch and FBI agent Bull corner the team, and Monday's secret makes her the main target.

title: Batman
blurb: Fraction and Scalera turn up the heat on Bad Seeds with the coldest villain in town. As the night wears on and the threat of dawn looms, Batman must search for answers from the one man capable of stopping Ivy and the bloom. Elsewhere, Verity Pennyworth must defend the Manor from all manner of threats—and they're about to discover they picked the wrong house to mess with.
